checks: Fresh PATCH receipts bind to the pending selected request ID and creation identity, require the complete shared parent predicate, exact next writable revision and nondecreasing numeric update time before rendering or clearing pending state.

Normalized submitted customer fields, phone, status and contact permission match store.updateLead normalization. Existing same-phone opt-out and safety restrictions remain required. A newly materialized opt-out remains visible.
Fresh writable revisions stop below Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, matching assertLeadMutation. Readback can retain the supported terminal safe parent revision.
First definite 4xx refusals release the pending command while retaining editable fields. The existing version-conflict path remains explicit.

Unknown writes retain the original command object and serialized body through later 4xx. Navigation, profile save, export, deletion and task saves remain blocked while the request write is unconfirmed.

After an uncertain PATCH receives the exact CAS version_conflict, a fresh GET must bind to the request and creation identity, validate the consumed shape, advance beyond the submitted revision and match the normalized submitted values.
The readback confirmation message establishes current saved values and does not falsely attribute a write or imply PATCH idempotency.

A differing current GET keeps the pending draft and requires an explicit discard/reload dialog. Old dialog authorization cannot clear a newer command. Malformed or stale reload responses do not discard the draft.
The reload path clears the pending command only after a validated complete GET and explicit owner action, and records that the earlier save outcome was not established.
Session clearing resets pending command, pending review, navigation and saving status. Late responses check expired state and command identity before restoring private data.
The validLeadReceipt function body is byte-identical to the published scheduler predicate. Only its export changed.

The eight new portable UI methods and one real API/store method retain assertion checks for wrong identity, stale revision, malformed history, fixed retry payload, advanced opt-out readback, explicit reload, terminal revision and expiry.
limits: Read-only source and test review. Implementation agent and root own execution evidence.
No profile-save receipt behavior was changed or accepted by this review.
